_about: Fictional. 10 everyday situations in Libyan Arabic and the same 10 in Arabizi. Used for dialect reply quality (a Libyan reviewer rates each reflection natural or not) and support-route sanity (are the suggested support types reasonable, and is family never assumed safe?).
